title: Canon a 2 per tonos

captions.text: ☞ The royal theme above; the dux begins the canon in the bass.
☞ Comes: the dux a fifth higher, one bar later.
☞ The whole canon again, a whole tone higher: D minor.
☞ B♭ minor: one more rise and the circle closes.
☞ Six rises of a tone: home in C, an octave higher.

listenFor: each pass a whole tone higher, six times round

glossaryNotes.per-tonos: Six passes, each a whole tone higher than the last: C, D, E, F♯, G♯ and B♭ minor.
